items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So it was a pretty interesting couple of years that you had with de Paris. Where did that band play besides New York? Did that band ever tour? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Eddie Gibbs was a banjo player.
Tell us a little about him. He's not very well known. Was he an older musician, around the age of de Paris? Or was he a young...?
Yeah, he was older than us.
